arguments.assumptions: FY2027 is a 53-week fiscal year ending January 31, 2027 (e41). Reported US-GAAP diluted EPS for the first six months is $4.85 (e4). Bear/base/bull full-year EPS assumptions of $8.85/$9.85/$10.85 therefore embed residual second-half EPS of $4.00/$5.00/$6.00, respectively, using a constant-share approximation; they are not management guidance or consensus. Bear tests AI-compute demand/mix or supply constraints reducing second-half profitability; base holds broadly similar per-quarter earnings despite the 14-week Q4; bull assumes demand and mix sustain stronger earnings. P/E inputs 18x/24x/30x are explicit stress assumptions, not observed, normal, fair, or probability-weighted multiples.

cases.rationale: Hypothetical demand/mix or supply constraint stress plus multiple compression.
Hypothetical sustained earnings through the unreported second half, with a 14-week Q4, at an assumed multiple.
Hypothetical stronger second-half demand/mix and continued premium multiple.
